text:
Noon stalled among damp chills.
+        The bored barracks pump bails out
+        time time time time.
+
+
+        Was Was.
+
+
+        Roosters song while scratching in vain.
+        Mouth of clear day conjugating
+        was was was was.
+
+
+        Tomorrow Tomorrow.
+
+
+        Rest still warm from being.
+        The present thinks keep me for
+        tomorrow tomorrow tomorrow tomorrow.
+
+
+        Name Name.
+
+
+        What is the name of all that bristles us?
+        Its name is Thesame that suffers
+        name name name name.

translation.title: Time, Time
translation.editorial_note: This distinct witness of Trilce II omits the opening Tiempo Tiempo and alters the final capitalization; the reviewed verbal mutations and its source-specific typography are preserved.
